% lp2graph canonical LaTeX
% Reversible with lp2graph.codec.from_canonical_latex (schema 0.1.0).
%@ meta id=rail_multi_disc family=milp schema=0.1.0
%@ name :: Multiple‑disruption railway timetable rescheduling
%@ desc :: MILP model for retiming, reordering, cancellation, short‑turning, and rolling‑stock circulation under overlapping disruptions. Includes platform capacity and stock limits.
%@ index S ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Stations.
%@ index T ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Trains.
%@ index K ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Discrete time slots (planning horizon).
%@ index D ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Disruptions.
%@ param orig_dep shape=T kind=vector domain=time :: Original departure time of each train.
%@ param travel shape=T,S kind=matrix domain=time :: Travel time from train start to station s.
%@ param cap_station shape=S,K kind=matrix domain=integer :: Platform capacity at station s in slot k.
%@ param stock shape=S kind=vector domain=integer :: Number of rolling‑stock units available at terminal station s.
%@ param penalty_delay shape=- kind=scalar domain=cost :: Cost per unit of train delay.
%@ param penalty_cancel shape=- kind=scalar domain=cost :: Cost per cancelled train.
%@ param penalty_shortturn shape=- kind=scalar domain=cost :: Cost per short‑turn activation.
%@ param M_big shape=- kind=scalar domain=bigM :: Large constant for big‑M formulations.
%@ param affected shape=D,S kind=matrix domain=binary :: 1 if disruption d affects station s.
%@ param terminal shape=T,S kind=matrix domain=binary :: 1 if train t terminates (or originates) at station s.
%@ param share_line shape=T,T kind=matrix domain=binary :: 1 if trains t1 and t2 share a line (potential conflict).
%@ var tau shape=T domain=continuous role=primary drole=- lo=0 hi=- :: Adjusted departure time of train t.
%@ var z shape=T domain=binary role=primary drole=cancellation lo=0 hi=1 :: Cancellation indicator for train t.
%@ var w shape=T,D domain=binary role=primary drole=shortturn lo=0 hi=1 :: Short‑turn activation of train t for disruption d.
%@ var y shape=T,S,K domain=binary role=primary drole=occupancy lo=0 hi=1 :: Occupancy of train t at station s during slot k.
%@ var o shape=T domain=integer role=primary drole=order lo=0 hi=- :: Sequencing order of train t on its line.
%@ var order shape=T,T domain=binary role=auxiliary drole=ordering_indicator lo=0 hi=1 :: Pairwise ordering: order_{t1,t2}=1 ⇒ t1 before t2.
%@ obj sense=min name=objective combination=sum :: Minimize weighted sum of delays, cancellations and short‑turns.
%@ con dep_nonneg kind=linear domain=- indicator=- :: Departure cannot be earlier than original.
%@ con dep_cancel_upper kind=linear domain=- indicator=- :: Departure time relaxed when cancelled.
%@ con occupancy_lower kind=linear domain=- indicator=- :: Lower bound linking departure and occupancy.
%@ con occupancy_upper kind=linear domain=- indicator=- :: Upper bound linking departure and occupancy.
%@ con capacity kind=linear domain=- indicator=- :: Platform capacity.
%@ con stock kind=linear domain=- indicator=- :: Rolling‑stock availability.
%@ con shortturn_cancel kind=linear domain=- indicator=- :: Short‑turn not allowed if cancelled.
%@ con shortturn_feas kind=linear domain=- indicator=- :: Short‑turn only if disruption touches train’s terminal.
%@ con order_exclusive kind=linear domain=- indicator=- :: Exactly one of two ordering directions.
%@ con order_before1 kind=linear domain=- indicator=- :: Ordering implication (t1 before t2).
%@ con order_before2 kind=linear domain=- indicator=- :: Ordering implication (t2 before t1).
\begin{align}
  \min\quad & \mathit{penalty\_delay} \cdot \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} \bigl( \tau_{t} - \mathit{orig\_dep}_{t} \bigr)
            + \mathit{penalty\_cancel} \cdot \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} z_{t}
            + \mathit{penalty\_shortturn} \cdot \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T},\, d \in \mathcal{D}} w_{t,d}
            \tag{objective} \\
  & \tau_{t} \ge \mathit{orig\_dep}_{t} \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T} \tag{dep\_nonneg} \\
  & \tau_{t} \le \mathit{orig\_dep}_{t} + \mathit{M\_big} \cdot (1 - z_{t}) \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T} \tag{dep\_cancel\_upper} \\
  & \tau_{t} + \mathit{travel}_{t,s} \ge k - \mathit{M\_big} \cdot (1 - y_{t,s,k}) \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T},\, s \in \mathcal{S},\, k \in \mathcal{K} \tag{occupancy\_lower} \\
  & \tau_{t} + \mathit{travel}_{t,s} \le k + 1 + \mathit{M\_big} \cdot (1 - y_{t,s,k}) \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T},\, s \in \mathcal{S},\, k \in \mathcal{K} \tag{occupancy\_upper} \\
  & \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} y_{t,s,k} \le \mathit{cap\_station}_{s,k} \qquad \forall s \in \mathcal{S},\, k \in \mathcal{K} \tag{capacity} \\
  & \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} \mathit{terminal}_{t,s} \cdot (1 - z_{t}) \le \mathit{stock}_{s} \qquad \forall s \in \mathcal{S} \tag{stock} \\
  & w_{t,d} \le 1 - z_{t} \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T},\, d \in \mathcal{D} \tag{shortturn\_cancel} \\
  & w_{t,d} \le \sum_{s \in \mathcal{S}} \mathit{affected}_{d,s} \cdot \mathit{terminal}_{t,s} \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T},\, d \in \mathcal{D} \tag{shortturn\_feas} \\
  & order_{t1,t2} + order_{t2,t1} = 1 \qquad \forall t1 \in \mathcal{T},\, t2 \in \mathcal{T},\; t1 \neq t2,\; \mathit{share\_line}_{t1,t2}=1 \tag{order\_exclusive} \\
  & o_{t1} + 1 \le o_{t2} + \mathit{M\_big} \cdot (1 - order_{t1,t2}) \qquad \forall t1 \in \mathcal{T},\, t2 \in \mathcal{T},\; t1 \neq t2,\; \mathit{share\_line}_{t1,t2}=1 \tag{order\_before1} \\
  & o_{t2} + 1 \le o_{t1} + \mathit{M\_big} \cdot order_{t1,t2} \qquad \forall t1 \in \mathcal{T},\, t2 \in \mathcal{T},\; t1 \neq t2,\; \mathit{share\_line}_{t1,t2}=1 \tag{order\_before2}
\end{align}

% lp2graph canonical LaTeX
% Generated MILP for multi‑disruption railway rescheduling.
%@ meta id=rail_multi_disruption family=milp schema=0.1.0
%@ name :: Multi‑disruption railway timetable rescheduling
%@ desc :: MILP model handling cancellations, delays, short‑turns, added stops and platform capacity under overlapping disruptions.
%@ index I ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Train services (each scheduled trip).
%@ index S ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Stations.
%@ index T ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Discrete time slots.
%@ index D ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Disruptions.
%@ param o shape=I kind=scalar domain=time :: Original departure time of service i.
%@ param dur shape=I kind=scalar domain=time :: Nominal travel duration of service i.
%@ param cancel_cost shape=I kind=scalar domain=cost :: Penalty cost for cancelling service i.
%@ param delay_cost shape=I kind=scalar domain=cost_per_time :: Penalty per unit delay for service i.
%@ param short_allowed shape=I kind=scalar domain=boolean :: 1 if service i may be short‑turned.
%@ param short_gain shape=I kind=scalar domain=time :: Time saved when service i is short‑turned.
%@ param add_stop_allowed shape=I,S kind=scalar domain=boolean :: 1 if service i may add a stop at station s.
%@ param add_stop_cost shape=I,S kind=scalar domain=cost :: Penalty for adding stop s to service i.
%@ param cap shape=S,T kind=scalar domain=integer :: Platform capacity at station s during time slot t.
%@ param travel shape=I,S kind=scalar domain=time :: Travel time from departure of service i to reaching station s (including normal dwell).
%@ param extra_stop_time shape=- kind=scalar domain=time :: Additional dwell time incurred by an added stop.
%@ param M shape=- kind=scalar domain=bigM :: Large constant for big‑M formulations.
%@ param disrupt_start shape=D kind=scalar domain=time :: Start time of disruption d.
%@ param disrupt_end shape=D kind=scalar domain=time :: End time of disruption d.
%@ param disrupt_station shape=D,S kind=scalar domain=boolean :: 1 if disruption d affects station s.
%@ param blocked shape=S,T kind=scalar domain=boolean :: 1 if station s is blocked at time t by any disruption.
%@ var y shape=I domain=binary role=primary drole=- lo=- hi=- :: 1 if service i is kept (not cancelled).
%@ var d shape=I domain=non_negative role=primary drole=- lo=0 hi=- :: Delay amount for service i.
%@ var s shape=I domain=binary role=primary drole=- lo=- hi=- :: 1 if service i is short‑turned.
%@ var z shape=I,S domain=binary role=primary drole=- lo=- hi=- :: 1 if an additional stop at station s is added to service i.
%@ var a shape=I,S domain=non_negative role=primary drole=- lo=0 hi=- :: Arrival time of service i at station s.
%@ var w shape=I,S,T domain=binary role=primary drole=- lo=- hi=- :: 1 if service i occupies station s at time slot t.
%@ obj sense=min name=total_cost combination=sum :: Minimize total penalty (cancellations, delays, added stops).
%@ con delay_if_kept kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Delay allowed only if service is kept.
%@ con short_allowed_keep kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Short‑turn allowed only if service is kept and permitted.
%@ con add_stop_permission kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Additional stop allowed only if permitted and service is kept.
%@ con arrival_time_def kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Definition of arrival time including delay, short‑turn and added stop.
%@ con link_upper kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Upper big‑M linking w and arrival time.
%@ con link_lower kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Lower big‑M linking w and arrival time.
%@ con occupy_once kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Each kept service occupies each station at exactly one time slot.
%@ con platform_capacity kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Platform capacity at each station and time slot.
%@ con blocked_no_occupancy kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: No occupation of blocked stations.
%@ con blocked_definition kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Definition of blocked slots from disruptions.
\begin{align}
  \min\quad & \sum_{i \in \mathcal{I}} \mathit{cancel\_cost}_{i} \cdot (1 - y_{i}) \;+\; \sum_{i \in \mathcal{I}} \mathit{delay\_cost}_{i} \cdot d_{i} \;+\; \sum_{i \in \mathcal{I}} \sum_{s \in \mathcal{S}} \mathit{add\_stop\_cost}_{i,s} \cdot z_{i,s} \tag{total\_cost} \\
  & d_{i} \le \mathit{M} \cdot y_{i} \qquad \forall i \in \mathcal{I} \tag{delay\_if\_kept} \\
  & s_{i} \le \mathit{short\_allowed}_{i} \cdot y_{i} \qquad \forall i \in \mathcal{I} \tag{short\_allowed\_keep} \\
  & z_{i,s} \le \mathit{add\_stop\_allowed}_{i,s} \cdot y_{i} \qquad \forall i \in \mathcal{I},\; s \in \mathcal{S} \tag{add\_stop\_permission} \\
  & a_{i,s} = o_{i} + d_{i} + \mathit{travel}_{i,s} - \mathit{short\_gain}_{i} \cdot s_{i} + \mathit{extra\_stop\_time} \cdot z_{i,s} \qquad \forall i \in \mathcal{I},\; s \in \mathcal{S} \tag{arrival\_time\_def} \\
  & a_{i,s} - t \le \mathit{M} \cdot (1 - w_{i,s,t}) \qquad \forall i \in \mathcal{I},\; s \in \mathcal{S},\; t \in \mathcal{T} \tag{link\_upper} \\
  & t - a_{i,s} \le \mathit{M} \cdot (1 - w_{i,s,t}) \qquad \forall i \in \mathcal{I},\; s \in \mathcal{S},\; t \in \mathcal{T} \tag{link\_lower} \\
  & \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} w_{i,s,t} = y_{i} \qquad \forall i \in \mathcal{I},\; s \in \mathcal{S} \tag{occupy\_once} \\
  & \sum_{i \in \mathcal{I}} w_{i,s,t} \le \mathit{cap}_{s,t} \qquad \forall s \in \mathcal{S},\; t \in \mathcal{T} \tag{platform\_capacity} \\
  & w_{i,s,t} \le 1 - \mathit{blocked}_{s,t} \qquad \forall i \in \mathcal{I},\; s \in \mathcal{S},\; t \in \mathcal{T} \tag{blocked\_no\_occupancy} \\
  & \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} \mathit{blocked}_{s,t} = \sum_{d \in \mathcal{D}} \bigl(\mathit{disrupt\_end}_{d} - \mathit{disrupt\_start}_{d} + 1\bigr) \cdot \mathit{disrupt\_station}_{d,s} \qquad \forall s \in \mathcal{S} \tag{blocked\_definition} \\
\end{align}
